 2214     #       item even if it was switched out by a Red Card. That doesn't make
 2215     #       sense, so this code doesn't do it.

 2218     next if !move.contactMove?

 2220     next if target.item || !user.item
 2221     next if user.unlosableItem?(user.item) || target.unlosableItem?(user.item)
